text: {"lessons":["Buying several stocks after they have risen can leave me exposed when prices fall; I should consider each trade’s risk and its effect on my whole portfolio.","I should not keep losing positions merely to avoid admitting a mistake, or sell winners just to lock in a gain; each decision should be based on the position’s merits now, not my average cost.","A few months of account gains or losses do not reveal what prices will do next; I should avoid reacting to recent performance and make deliberate decisions consistent with my risk limits."]}
